commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
90+4' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.

66' Dean Henderson displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

50' Surely that's handball by one of the Crystal Palace players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
50' What a great touch by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked.
49' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
47' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
47' It seemed like Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
